messages:
priya (release-manager): RC created: inference-runtime v2.8.1-rc3. CI green, integration tests pass. Requesting preflight sign-off for tonight's change window 23:00-02:00 PST. Link: https://ci.redwood/inference/rc/2.8.1-rc3 :rocket:

deploy-bot: Build 2.8.1-rc3 pushed to staging and canary clusters. Canary target: 5% traffic to canary-1 (us-west). Pipeline: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/9876

alex (eng-runtime): I'll run the smoke test matrix on canary-1 now. Focus on latency p95 and memory growth for long-context.

anya (qa): Running prompt-fuzz and eval set A against rc3. Will report regressions in 15m.

samir (sre-oncall): SLO impact check: healthchecks, autoscaler, and KV cache metrics observed. Will monitor during canary.

kevin (product): Any known behavior changes in output that product teams should be aware of?

alex (eng-runtime): No functional changes expected; performance optimizations in attention kernel. Could change token timings but not outputs. We have a changelog snippet in the release notes.

priya (release-manager): Can we get explicit +1 from eng-runtime, qa, and oncall before promote? Please prefix with +1.

anya (qa): +1 from QA pending the eval suite - I see one flaky test `long_context_splitter.test_boundary` failing intermittently (10% failure rate). Investigating now.

alex (eng-runtime): I'm looking at that flaky test. It seems related to padding edge-case. I can patch early if it's blocking, but it's low risk for prod. Suggest we proceed with a limited canary and watch.

samir (sre-oncall): Traffic will be routed to canary-1 only. If p95 latency > 300ms or 5xx rate > 0.2% for more than 3 minutes we abort and rollback. Runbook: `/runbook rollback-canary` or manual: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:2.8.0`

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: 5% -> 10% over 10m. Canary ID: canary-2025-03-03-rc3. Notifying SSO groups.

anya (qa): Update: the flaky test reproduces locally with seed 42. I pushed a test-only tweak to skip the nondeterministic assertion. Patch MR: https://git.redwood/qa/patches/124

marc (infra): Observing host-level metrics: GPU memory stable, but kernel scheduler shows slight increase in spin wait. Noted. Will keep an eye.

alex (eng-runtime): Rolling a small instrumentation build to log KV cache hit ratio on canary. If we see a dip > 5% that's actionable.

priya (release-manager): Given flaky test and the infra observation, propose: promote to prod for non-critical customers but pin Dedicated customers on 2.8.0 for 24h. Can we do that?

kevin (product): Agree with a cautious rollout. Pinning Dedicated customers needs ops playbook update and customer comms. I'll draft a short note.

samir (sre-oncall): I can apply pin via routing rule: `route.v1.customers.dedicated -> inference:2.8.0` for affected customers. Will script the toggle.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (10m): p95=210ms (baseline 200ms), 5xx=0.03%, KV cache hit ratio -0.8% from baseline. No urgent alerts.

anya (qa): After skipping flaky assertion, full eval suite passes. No semantic regressions detected.

alex (eng-runtime): Given metrics, +1 from runtime for staged promotion with Dedicated pin.

priya (release-manager): OK, official sign-off: +1 (eng-runtime), +1 (qa), +1 (sre) conditional on the Dedicated pin. Moving to staged promotion. Change window 23:00-02:00 PST tonight.

deploy-bot: Promotion plan executed: canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 hours. Pin applied for Dedicated customers: `route.dedicated=2.8.0` (effective). Notifications sent to `#customer-updates`.

samir (sre-oncall): Monitoring the first 30 minutes of full rollout. Escalation threshold: p95>350ms or error rate >0.5% sustained 3 minutes.

marc (infra): Noting post-promotion housekeeping: update infra tag mapping and CDN warmers. I'll run `infra/upgrade-mapping` job.

kevin (product): I've posted a short note for affected customers and a flag in the dashboard. Will follow up with direct messages to the top 5 Dedicated accounts.

priya (release-manager): If we see regression, immediate rollback plan: revert routing to 2.8.0 and open a hotfix MR with `cherry-pick -x`. Escalate to oncall and eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All stages green. Change window still open.

samir (sre-oncall): First 45m post-promotion: p95=215ms, 5xx=0.02%, autoscaler behavior normal. No rollback.

anya (qa): Closing QA checklist. Will run nightly regression run and schedule postmortem if any issues surface.

priya (release-manager): Thanks team. I'll close the RC tracking ticket and publish release notes with the Dedicated pin note. :thumbsup:

alex (eng-runtime): Logged follow-ups: 1) fix flaky test root cause, 2) investigate scheduler spin wait. Creating issues.

kevin (product): Can we add a blurb in release notes: "2.8.1-rc3 staged; Dedicated customers temporarily pinned to 2.8.0. No semantic changes; perf tuning only." I'll send wording.

priya (release-manager): Copy that. Good job everyone.
